chunks: Hold fast, all of you, to the rope of God and do not be divided, and remember the favour of God upon you when you were enemies and He reconciled your hearts so that by His favour you became brothers, and you were on the brink of a pit of Fire and He saved you from it; thus does God make clear to you His signs so that you may be guided.

key_terms.لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ: so that you may be guided

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about unity and God's favor among the believers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'holding firmly to the rope of Allah' is often interpreted as adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams, who serve as the tangible manifestation of divine unity. This verse underscores the theological necessity of communal cohesion, linking the historical reconciliation of the Ansar and Muhajirun to the eschatological salvation of the Ummah through divine grace.
